title: RetrieveRequest
description: Request to retrieve relevant chunks without generating an answer.

filters.description: Metadata equality constraints, ANDed. A value is a string, an integer or a boolean, or a list of strings or a list of integers (membership) — one type per list, booleans only as scalars, and an empty list matches nothing (issue #196). The bound is what Qdrant's MatchValue/MatchAny can represent: float, null, an object, a nested list, a boolean inside a list and a mixed str/int list are all refused with 400. Range operators such as {"gte": 2025} are NOT supported. Values are matched by type, never coerced: `year` is an integer field, so {"year": "2025"} is a 400 rather than a silent zero-hit read (issue #471).

rerank.description: Per-request rerank control. null (default) preserves the server-wide default; false forces a rerank skip; true is a no-op when no reranker is wired.

rerank_candidates.description: Override for the candidate-pool depth fed to the reranker. null (default) uses the server default (max(top_k, server's rerank_candidates)).

collection.description: Registry collection id to retrieve from. null (default) uses the default collection; an unknown id returns 404. See GET /v1/collections.

collections.description: Multi-collection fused retrieval (issue #253): registry collection ids to retrieve from together. Every id is resolved and read-authorized BEFORE any retrieval runs (an unknown or unreadable id is a 404 for the whole request — no partial answers; a dormant member is a 503 + Retry-After for the whole request); then one single-collection retrieval leg runs per id, concurrently, the legs are fused with RRF, reranked once over the union and cut to top_k. Each returned Source carries the member it came from in `collection`; a document present in two collections appears once per collection. Mutually exclusive with `collection` (both → 422). 1 to 5 unique ids (more, duplicates, or an empty list → 422); a single id behaves exactly like `collection`. Never expressed as one many-valued store filter — one leg per collection.

retrieval_mode.description: Retrieval legs: hybrid (dense + BM25, RRF-fused), vector (dense only), or bm25 (sparse only). The graph leg is orthogonal (use_graph).

context_window.description: Server-side context expansion (issue #322): after fusion, rerank and the top_k cut, walk each returned source's prev_chunk_id / next_chunk_id up to this many hops each way and attach the neighbours as the Source's context (ranking unchanged; never merged into the scored list). Scoped by the same filters and tenant scope as the retrieval; a neighbour the caller may not read is omitted; a neighbour that is itself a returned source is not duplicated. 0 (default) leaves the response as before. Above 3 is a 422.

reranker.description: Registered model id to rerank with for THIS request only. Unknown id 404; non-reranker model 400. See GET /v1/models/available.
